title: Tolerance statement
description: One sentence, written by leadership: 'The company will / will not carry [exposure] beyond [threshold].' Five to seven total. Every risk's residual compares to one.

statement.description: The company will / will not carry <exposure> beyond <threshold>. Readable and signable by a non-technical executive.

owner.description: The executive who wrote and signs it.

breached_since.description: Set when roll-up exceeds threshold. Two consecutive quarters breached without a decision forces review.
